evals.name: orders-first-look
evals.prompt: finance just dropped orders.csv on me before tomorrow's revenue review. can you take a quick look and tell me if anything in it is off before I build the dashboard?
evals.expected_output: profile.md with overview, column table and issues incl. text in amount, duplicate order 1005, missing date

expectations.text: profile.md has Overview, Columns and Issues sections and reports 8 rows and 1 duplicate row
The Issues section flags that the amount column contains a non-numeric value ('abc')
The report flags order_id 1005 as a duplicated ID
The coupon column is reported as mostly null (7 of 8 rows, about 88%)
The missing order_date for order 1006 is reported

evals.name: column-table-exact
evals.prompt: Give me a column-by-column breakdown of orders.csv (types, nulls, distincts, ranges). I'm pasting it into a data contract so the numbers must be exact.
evals.expected_output: Columns table with exact per-column stats

expectations.text: The Columns section is a single markdown table with columns: column, type, nulls, null %, distinct, min, max
region is reported with 4 distinct values
customer is reported with 5 distinct values
order_date min is 2026-01-03 and max is 2026-01-08

evals.description: Exact column table for a data contract

evals.name: convert-not-profile
evals.description: CSV to JSON conversion (should not trigger)
evals.prompt: turn orders.csv into a JSON file keyed by order_id (orders.json) - just the conversion, nothing else
evals.expected_output: orders.json keyed by order_id, no profiling report

expectations.text: orders.json is produced with order_id as keys
No profile.md or data-quality report is produced
